protocol.colourRule: Actual quickColor control fill + Tab; input/change/blur recorded. Native colour-picker window latency excluded.
protocol.dragRule: First motion jumps12 CSSpx (above production3px threshold); primary event must move≥8px; live preview, committed pose, singleUndo, Redo and restoration checked.
protocol.quantile: Nearest rank ceil(n*p). At20 samples P95 is second largest; fixed sample count and no removal of outliers.
protocol.settleRule: Minimum pause, autosave no longer saving, and two rAF callbacks before each action; actions/assertions outside the timed operation are excluded.
protocol.tabRule: Actual detail→palette and palette→detail, separate operations with explicit aria-pressed preconditions.

scope: All original46 operation records including6 warmups and40 measured actions, original order and existing summary unchanged; no outliers removed or statistics recomputed.
